headline: Derby go to Bramall Lane without their first-choice keeper
summary: Derby go to Bramall Lane 23rd in the Championship with 6 points, and no win in their last 5 games. The bigger problem is the defence: first-choice goalkeeper Widell Zetterstrom is out after 8 league games, and defender Langas, 917 minutes this season, is missing too. Derby have added veteran defender Jack Robinson on a short deal. Sheffield United won 1-0 at Bristol City last Saturday and are 52% favourites. The handicap rates them 0.6 goals the better side, with 2.6 goals expected — the market expects a narrow home win, not a rout.
read: Sheffield Utd are the clear favourites at home, with the market rating them about 0.6 goals the better side and pricing them at 52.0% against Derby's 24.1%. Derby arrive 23rd with one win all season and a defence missing its goalkeeper and several regulars, while the goals line of 2.62 suggests the market expects an open game rather than a grind.

facts.fact: Sheffield Utd are the clear favourites at 52.0% to win, more than double Derby's 24.1% chance, with the draw at 23.9%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the home side comfortably the more likely winner at Bramall Lane.

facts.fact: Derby sit 23rd of 24 with only six points from 11 games, one win, three draws and seven defeats.
facts.meaning: They arrive in the bottom three and needing a result to kickstart their season.

facts.fact: Derby's last five Championship results read LLDDL: two draws and three defeats, four goals scored and nine conceded.
facts.meaning: No win in five and a defence conceding nearly two a game going into a tough away trip.

facts.fact: Derby are without goalkeeper J. Widell Zetterstrom, who has played 725 minutes this season at a rating of 7.27.
facts.meaning: The last line of an already struggling defence has to be reshuffled for the trip to Bramall Lane.

facts.fact: Derby are also missing defender S. Langas, who has played 917 minutes this season, plus fellow defenders C. Taylor (774 minutes) and C. Forsyth.
facts.meaning: Three regular defenders out means a patched-up back line against a home side that has just won away.

facts.fact: Sheffield Utd won 1-0 away at Bristol City on 17 October, their second win in three league games.
facts.meaning: They come in on an upturn and with a clean sheet on the road.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is Sheffield Utd -0.6, with the main line at -0.5.
facts.meaning: The market rates Sheffield Utd roughly two-thirds of a goal the better side, so a one-goal home win is the midpoint, not a comfortable margin.

facts.fact: The market's fair goals line is 2.62, with Over 2.5 priced at 52.7%.
facts.meaning: Around two and a half to three goals are expected — slightly on the open side for a Championship game.

sources.fact: Sheffield United have won two of their last three Championship matches and climbed to within touching distance of the play-off places.
Sheffield United won 1-0 away at Bristol City in the Championship.
Chris Wilder believes Sheffield United can turn their gruelling run of away fixtures into an advantage with Derby County and Wrexham visiting Bramall Lane.
Sheffield United lost 3-2 at Portsmouth, playing with 10 men, before their recent upturn.
Derby County head coach John Eustace says he hopes Lewis Travis' injury, sustained in the Stoke City match, is not serious.
Derby County signed experienced defender Jack Robinson, a former Sheffield United player, on a three-month deal ahead of the Bramall Lane trip.
Derby County have been described as injury-hit ahead of the Sheffield United match.
Derby County are described as Championship strugglers and are looking for a win at Sheffield United to kickstart their season.
